race.comment: CRAZY EIGHTS (1) had shown ability at the trials before just finding one quicker at Doomben on debut. Will have taken a lot a benefit from that race day experience and gets a bunch of weight relief with the 3kg claim. Looks to have a bit of upside and can play a major role in the finish. WEOWNACHEVY (4) was well in the betting at Doomben last time out but didn't have the best of luck on that occasion. Ready to peak now third run back and where there's smoke there's fire. Looms as the main danger. THREEEYEDWITCH (2) has hit the top-four in all six career efforts to date and is working up to a maiden victory. Top-three aspirations. WIN STAR (10) is ready to the step-up in trip now and must be respected out of the Munce barn. In the mix. HIT A LICK (9) next best with Thompson in the stirrups.
